title: Gilda Lozoya, Sister of Ex-Pemex CEO Emilio Lozoya, Detained in Agronitrogenados Case
detail: Gilda Susana Lozoya Austin, sister of former Pemex CEO Emilio Lozoya Austin, was detained by FGR agents near Mexico City International Airport on July 2, 2026, on a 2020 arrest warrant executed six years later. Prosecutors accuse her of acting as a 'prestanombres' (front person) for Tochos Holding Limited, a Swiss bank account through which Emilio Lozoya allegedly channeled illicitly-sourced funds. The FGR alleges that between June 12 and November 28, 2012, Gilda received five bank transfers totaling millions of dollars from Alonso Ancira Elizondo — owner of Altos Hornos de México (AHMSA), the company at the center of the Agronitrogenados fertilizer-plant overpricing scheme — and that part of those resources financed real-estate purchases now subject to extinction-of-domain proceedings. Her detention revived public attention on the Odebrecht/Agronitrogenados cases just weeks after the FGR seized Emilio Lozoya's own Lomas de Bezares mansion.
